claims: Artemis II astronauts splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at 5:07 p.m. PDT.
The Artemis II mission lasted 10 days.
The Orion capsule was recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
Artemis II was the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
The Artemis program is designed to return humans to the vicinity of the moon and back.
